dialogues.speaker: Valerina
dialogues.text: How about it, Cat Savior and Cat Whisperer? You find Dodocos fuzzy, fluffy, bouncy, and absolutely positively huggable too, don't you?

choices.text: Another Dodoco fan joins the party, eh?

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Absolutely! My current goal is to support Ematol and spread the word of the Spark Knight's might. And, of course, that of Dodoco's cuteness!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: That's why I'm planning to invest ten million Mora to try and mass-produce this tabletop game to make it more popular.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Sorry, HOW much Mora now!? Wow, you're no ordinary fan, that's for sure...

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: But we'll have to wait until the game's trial is over to collect feedback from all our players.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Then, with further refinements by the actual developer, Ematol, we'll make sure it's easy to pick up and fun for everyone!

choices.text: About the Dodocos and their in-game opponents...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, Paimon's curious, too. Just where did Ematol get her inspiration?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #They're based on Klee, Kaeya, Lisa, and {NICKNAME}. Heehee, Paimon feels at home just looking at 'em!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Well, Ematol's the developer here...

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: So I asked her a similar question, and her answer was very convincing!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: #"{NICKNAME}, Sir Kaeya, and Ms. Lisa are all renowned Mondstadters, as well as the pillars of the Knights of Favonius!"

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: You've all fought alongside the Spark Knight for many, many years... So, naturally, it's about time you made your tabletop debut!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: A hero's story is not a one-man show, but a collective symphony of willpower, courage, and wisdom!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: So, even while we tell the story of the Spark Knight, her companions need to all get the spotlight they deserve!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Klee's got other friends besides us, though.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: I know! But these are just the ones we have for the trial. We've got plans for Master Jean, the Helper in White, Mr. Albedo, Miss Amber, Miss Eula... The list goes on and on and on.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, Paimon gets a Dodoco too!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wild Shape: Paimodoco!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: As for the opponents this time, they were all designed by Ematol based on intel that the expedition team sent back.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: I think she said she referenced the monsters and foes they found in Nod-Krai...

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Well, it's a mysterious, faraway place that none of us have been to. That's why it's perfect as the setting for an adventure!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: In the future, who knows? Dodoco's story may evolve into... an adventure in another world, maybe?

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: I'm gonna sponsor this as best I can, and witness the grand rise of this tabletop game!

choices.text: The last time we met was...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And you even called Paimon "Cat Whisperer," which rings a bell...

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Well, it has been a while.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Last we met, I'd run into some trouble while running a stray cat shelter... but thanks to your help and Miss Rosaria's support, we pulled through!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: After learning a few tricks from you, Cat Whisperer, the cats stopped disliking me, and everything went according to plan!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: But not long after the shelter's trial run began, I got recruited by an old friend's team for a long adventure.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: And thank the winds I did, because our team ran into lots of strange puzzles during said adventure. If I hadn't been there, someone might've gotten hurt...

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: I only just returned to Mondstadt. Now I'm tidying things up to reopen the shelter and get things up and running again.

choices.text: Ah, I remember!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You ran the Furball Fortress, right?

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: That's the one!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Snowball, Bunny, Dustball, and Dopey all miss you! If you have time, come visit us!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: And allow me to ask, how has Sir Pouncelot been?

choices.text: Splendid, of course.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, Valerina! Sir Pouncelot's got more than enough to eat, and every day is an easy-breezy day!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: That's wonderful! Let me think... What sort of dessert should I make? Hmm... Regardless, I'll trust you two to get it to him!

choices.text: He's a very happy cat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, come to think of it, Paimon hasn't seen Sir Pouncelot in a while... Next time we're back in the Realm Within, she'll go play with him!

choices.text: I'm afraid that doesn't ring any bells...

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Well, that's fine! You two must be terribly busy all the time. You probably see more strangers every week than I'd see in three years.

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: If I didn't leave an impression, that just means I wasn't impressive enough. I'll just have to do my best to become a famous adventurer worth remembering!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Next time we meet, I'll make sure you remember me instantly — along with all the wonderful moments we've shared!

choices.text: Let's talk more later!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll come back, don't you worry!

response.speaker: Valerina
response.text: Alrighty! I'll be right here, waiting for you!

dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: My head doesn't hurt as much... I suppose eating sweets does help...

dialogues.speaker: Ematol
dialogues.text: What are you thanking me for!? No need to be so formal!

dialogues.speaker: Ematol
dialogues.text: You need to get better and get back to work. Everyone's waiting for you!

choices.text: Afternoon tea? Do you have space for one more?

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Honorary Knight!

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: #{M#Sir}{F#Lady} {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why do you look upset?

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: ...It's been a while, but seeing you still makes me feel guilty.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh, you mean that incident from before...

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Umm... Honorary Knight, are you sure you want to talk about that...?

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Just thinking about the Durin incident still sends shivers down my spine... so...

choices.text: I'm sure Phonia's ready to talk.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: ...That's right. I can't run from this.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: #Please allow me to report the situation to you, {M#Sir}{F#Lady} Honorary Knight.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: During the incident, the Acting Grand Master exposed the fact that Durin had influenced my mind, and ordered the knights to escort me back to headquarters immediately...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: In my confinement cell, I heard the sound of fireworks coming from outside, followed by a strange burst of... something.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: It was like... Waking up from an eerie dream, and having your mind suddenly cleared.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Only then did I slowly realize the terrible things I'd done...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Afterwards, Captain Albedo and Miss Sucrose made me some soothing potions, and I've since gradually recovered from all the negative aftereffects of Durin's influence.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Captain Albedo treated the other affected knights with the same method, and soon, we returned to normal.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: After confirming that I was alright, the Acting Grand Master gave me an extended vacation. She probably hoped I'd recover during this time.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: But even after my vacation ended, I've still been struggling with stress. So... I won't be able to return to my post for the time being.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Nobody blames you for this, Phonia. After all, who could've predicted that Durin would... you know...

choices.text: You were a victim in all that.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: *sigh*... Back then, I didn't even realize something was wrong.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: I was thinking about how Phonia got transferred to the 7th Company and was part of a major operation... and whether we should hold a banquet to celebrate.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: I didn't expect things to turn out like this...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Looking back now, Durin's influence likely came into play during the seventh round of extreme-cold environment gear testing.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: During the test, I came too close to its still-dangerous remains, and when I returned, I felt sick and weak... I was on the verge of fainting while writing my report.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Captain Albedo must have realized from reading my substandard report that I'd been affected.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: That's why he transferred me to the 7th Company to take part in the simulation once my condition had stabilized somewhat.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Perhaps it was because I was in that important role that Durin marked me as a key informant then.

choices.text: So wouldn't the results of the simulation have been...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Well, I did give it my all, so yes, I did come up with some new tactics.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: But please don't worry, my tactical knowledge hasn't compromised Mondstadt's defenses in any way.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: After looking back on things more carefully, I realized that Captain Albedo and the Acting Grand Master, through their own clever methods, had been controlling the information that Durin was able to glean from me...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: They were thus able to control Durin's plan of attack in reverse, to a certain extent.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Controlling Durin in reverse... Sounds like they were working real magic...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Every combat strategy report I submitted was reviewed jointly by the Acting Grand Master and trusted Captains to determine whether they would be adopted.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Unaware that his informant had been compromised, Durin believed the adopted strategy would shape the Knights' latest defensive tactics.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: But in reality, this strategy was nothing more than bait.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Ooh, so that's how it was!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: No wonder so many of our colleagues mentioned training in "new tactics" — only for us to use a completely different plan during our defensive battle...

choices.text: So you took advantage of the information being leaked...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: That's right. During the battle, the main attacking force of monsters behaved just as the Knights foresaw — they moved to counter the strategy they thought we would use.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: But in the end, that allowed the Knights to take the initiative, minimizing the damage to our city and citizens.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Still, I can't afford to be complacent. Even intentionally leaked intel might trigger unexpected reactions from the monsters around Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Since recovering, I've run 830 simulations based on Durin's intel and had Ematol deliver the analyses to Captain Albedo...

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: But he assured me that the dust had settled, and there was nothing we needed to worry about.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: So, Phonia! Your top priority right now is to rest up, get better, and come back to us as soon as possible!

choices.text: That's right. There's nothing to worry about now.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: I see...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Then I'll write a detailed report based on my own experience to serve as a warning to those who come after us.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: I hope the other knights will take what happened to me to heart and take care out in the wild... Last thing we want is more of us falling under the control of strange forces...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Maybe we can develop this into some sort of specialized discipline? Like... "Psychic Disruption and Prevention"?

choices.text: Albedo took care of everything.
...To lure the enemy into doing something predictable.
So Durin adopted the all-new strategies from that simulation...
Being extra vigilant next time couldn't hurt.
Let's talk about something more relaxing, then.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Mhm! When you eat desserts, the conversation should be just as sweet!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Phonia and I made a new friend recently. She's a very passionate adventurer!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: She plans to reopen her shelter for stray animals. Maybe you'll be able to visit her soon.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: If you don't mind, shall we visit her together, Honorary Knight?

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: I'm curious to see what kind of cats you'd be fond of!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Also — big news! I've revamped Dodoco's Boom-Bastic Escapades into a cooperative adventure game: Dodoco's Blow-Up-Erative Bomb-Nanza!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: When I played it with my new friend, we had loads of fun! I want to promote the game, so I've asked her to help with that.

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: The game table is in the garden near the Knights of Favonius headquarters. Feel free to check it out whenever you're free!

choices.text: Sounds great!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: Phonia, once you're feeling better, let's invite your partner from the 7th Company. We can try out the game together!

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: I remember Captain Albedo saying that once the basic framework of their reconnaissance system is in place, your duties will be fully transferred to her — and you'll be transferred back here...

response.speaker: Ematol
response.text: It's going to be hard work for her, so let's make up for it in advance by having fun!

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Alright. I think she has a few months until her transfer to Dornman Port, so she'll probably have some free time.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: And it's probably time for me to do something to lift my mood, anyways.

choices.text: I'll definitely give it a try!
(Best not to bother them further...)
